name: Gebrinius

attributes.attribute: is identified by the Romans with Mars
appears in inscriptions in Celtic and Germanic lands
is equated by Koch with Mercurius Gebrinius of Bonn, eastern Gaul

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gebrinius is a Continental Celtic god. The Romans identified him with their warrior divinity Mars. Inscriptions naming him come from lands settled by both Celts and Germans, so his culture of origin is unclear. Koch separately treats Gebrinius as Mercurius Gebrinius, attested by ten inscriptions at Bonn in eastern Gaul.

okr.objective: Document Gebrinius as a Continental Celtic deity with contested culture of origin.
key_results: Establish Gebrinius as a Deity-typed Celtic god
Record the Roman equation with Mars
Note the Koch cross-reference to Mercurius Gebrinius of eastern Gaul
